title: Beyond Horizons Shaders
description: A cinematic Iris shader focused on skies, atmosphere, and lighting, designed for immersive and performance-friendly visuals.
body:
Optifine is currently broken. We are working on fixing it! 

**Beyond Horizons** is a cinematic shader pack designed for immersive skies, atmospheric lighting, and smooth performance in Minecraft.

It transforms the world with realistic sun and moon rendering, dynamic multi-layer clouds, enhanced sunsets, soft bloom, and atmospheric scattering that brings depth to every biome.

Built with Iris in mind, Beyond Horizons aims to balance visual beauty with performance, making it suitable for both survival gameplay and cinematic screenshots.

Features
• Realistic sun & moon rendering
• Dynamic multi-layer clouds
• Cinematic sunrise & sunset lighting
• Atmospheric fog & scattering
• Enhanced night sky
• Bloom & light glow effects
• Improved water visuals
• Dynamic weather effects

Supported
Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1
Iris Shaders (recommended)
Sodium compatible

Experience Minecraft beyond the horizon.
